name: Advanced Fluid Mechanics & Compressible Flow
summary: Viscous and inviscid flow theory, boundary layers, turbulence and compressible gas dynamics for engineering applications.

topics.name: Navier-Stokes equations and exact solutions (Couette, Poiseuille, Stokes problems)
Laminar boundary-layer theory (Blasius, integral methods) and separation
Turbulence: Reynolds averaging, turbulent boundary layers, mixing length
Normal and oblique shock waves; Prandtl-Meyer expansion
Flow with friction (Fanno) and heat addition (Rayleigh)
Introduction to multiphase flow (bubbles, droplets, cavitation)
Experimental fluid mechanics: wind tunnels, PIV, hot-wire anemometry
